intervals.label: operating (hosted Neutrino-4 2014-2021)
intervals.note: Start is the first Neutrino-4 measurement (detector model). The interval is left open because no source consulted says the SM-3 reactor itself has stopped; its own commissioning date is not sourced here.
intervals.quote: The experiment Neutrino-4 had started in 2014 with a detector model and then was continued with a full-scale detector in 2016 - 2021.

name: SM-3 research reactor, Dimitrovgrad (RIAR)
notes: Facility status is `active` because no source consulted says the SM-3 reactor itself has stopped; the interval only covers the Neutrino-4 use.

operator.note: RIAR is the affiliation of the Neutrino-4 co-authors who run the reactor site; the paper does not state the reactor operator in so many words.
operator.quote: JSC “State Science Center Research Institute of Atomic Reactors”, 433510 Dimitrovgrad, Russia
operator.value: State Science Center Research Institute of Atomic Reactors (RIAR), JSC

summary.plain: A compact, highly enriched uranium research reactor in the Russian city of Dimitrovgrad, run by the Research Institute of Atomic Reactors, where the Neutrino-4 experiment measured antineutrinos from 6 to 12 metres away.
summary.technical: SM-3 research reactor of the State Science Center Research Institute of Atomic Reactors (RIAR), Dimitrovgrad, Russia: compact 42 x 42 x 35 cm^3 core, highly enriched 235U, 90 MW thermal power; host of the Neutrino-4 experiment.
